messages:
Ana (product): FYI — telemetry spike: v1 routing up ~3x for last 6h vs baseline. lots of customers hitting legacy header. any suggestions before we flip canaries?
Devon: :thinking: are these from dedicated tenants or hosted? segmentation?
Samir: looks multi-tenant; sampling shows 60% from tokens created pre-2023 that still set `X-Client-Version: v1`. varied user agents.
Jordan (infra): If we route by header we can opt-in per-tenant in console, but quotas will still be charged under v2 pricing unless we map. need billing sync.
Maya (console): we can expose a 'compat mode' toggle in tenant settings. question: should toggle affect billing meter (token-level) or just route?
Ana (product): Ideally toggle should be UX-first: avoid bill surprises. prefer 'graceful mapping' where v1 clients get routed to v2 runtime but billed at v1 quota until grace ends.
Devon: tricky — billing pipelines are batched. we can add a `grace_label` tag on usage and roll forward pricing later, but it adds reconciliation work.
Samir: also need to preserve model-variant fallback. current routing code: `if X-Client-Version == 'v1' -> route v1_pool else -> v2_pool`. could swap to `route by tenant.override || header`.
Jordan (infra): patch in config looks like:
```
route_precedence:
  - tenant_override
  - compatibility_header
  - default
```
but we must ensure sticky affinity and cache keys include `compat_label`.
Maya (console): dashboard copy: 'Compatibility mode (temporary): Routes v1 client requests to v2 runtime with billing protection'. need telemetry flag to surface usage split in the tenant view.
Ana (product): agree. telemetry requirements: per-token label, prior-token creation date, routed_runtime, price_applied. sampling at 1% not enough — need 100% for billing reconciliation but aggregated for dashboard.
Devon: we can emit full labels to internal billing topic and high-cardinality metrics only to aggregation; add `compat_grace=true` tag.
ops-bot: deploy scheduled to canary cluster at 1715140300 by @Devon. Config: `compat_toggle_v1=true`
Jordan (infra): watch out for quota enforcement — if we let v1 clients hit v2 runtime but still apply v1 quotas, we may blow capacity. need autoscale policy override or soft-limit throttle.
Samir: propose soft-throttle: emit `429` with `Retry-After` and friendly message on console when grace exhausted.
Maya (console): UX todo: add a billing preview panel showing delta if they opt out of compat mode. we'll show estimated monthly delta.
Ana (product): OK plan: 1) patch routing ordering + labels, 2) emit billing-tagged events, 3) console toggle + billing preview, 4) canary 24h monitoring on latency/cost. who owns step 2?
Devon: infra will own tagging + topic. Jordan owns autoscale tweaks. Maya owns console. Samir will add throttle behavior. I'll coordinate deploy.
Ana (product): thanks. set follow-up doc in confluence, and flag SRE if we see >5% latency regression. :thumbsup:
